ण: ण The nasal Ṇ belonging to the third or cerebral class of consonants; in derivation and inflection this is usually changed to न or the dental N, and hence the derivatives from the following radicals occur under that letter.

ण m. (णः) 1 Knowledge. 2 Certainty, ascertainment. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 Vindudeva, said to be a Jaina deity. 5 An ornament. 6 A water or summer house. 7 One without good qualities. 8 A kind of sound, the sound of negation. 9 Gift, giving. E. णी to guide, &c. affix ड.
णक्ष: णक्ष r. 1st cl. (नक्षति, or with प्र prefixed प्रणक्षति) To go, to move, to approach.
णख: णख r. 1st cl. (नखति) also (इ) णखि r. 1st cl. (नंखति) To go, to move; also नख.
णट: णट r. 1st cl. (नटति प्रणटति) 1 To dance. 2 To dance as an actor, to gesticulate, to act; also नट. 3 To hurt.
णद: णद r. 1st cl. (नदति प्रणदति) To sound inarticulately, to roar as a river or a wild beast, to ring as a bell, &c. r. 10th cl. (नादयति) 1 To speak or tell, to shine.
णभ: णभ r. 1st cl. (नभते प्रणभते) 4th cl. (नभ्यति) and 9th cl. (नभ्नाति) 1 To kill, to injure. 2 To be annihilated, to cease to be.
णम: णम r. 1st cl. (नमति) 1 To salute with reverence or respect. 2 To bow or bend, to bow down in homage or worship. 3 To sound. With अव or आङ् or सम् prefixed, To bend down, to decline. With प्र, To bow, to salute. With उत्, To lift up, to raise, to make straight or erect.
णय: णय r. 1st cl. (नयते प्रणयते) 1 To go, to move or approach. 2 To preserve, to protect, to defend.
णर्द: णर्द r. 1st cl. (नर्दति प्रणर्दति) To sound; also नर्द.
णल: णल r. 1st cl. (नलति प्रणलति) 1 To smell. 2 To bind.
णश: णश r. 4th cl. (ऊ) णशू (नश्यति) To disappear, to cease to be, to perish, to be annihilated.
णस: णस r. 1st cl. (नसते प्रणसते) 1 To be crooked, (literally or metaphorically.) 2 To bend, to make curved or crooked.
णह: णह r. 4th cl. (औ) औनह (नह्यति नह्यते) To bind, to tie. With सभ prefixed, (सन्नाहति) To arm, to put on mail or military accoutrements.
णास: णास (ऋ) णासृ r. 1st cl. (नासते प्रणासते) To sound in a particular manner, to snore.
णिक्ष: णिक्ष r. 1st cl. (निक्षति प्रणिक्षति) To kill: the change of the ण after a preposition is optional in the derivatives of this root.
णिज: णिज (इ) णिजि r. 2nd cl. (निंक्ते प्रणिंक्ते) To cleanse, (औ, इर) औणिजिर r. 3rd cl. (नेनेक्ति नेनिक्ते) 1 To nurture, to cherish or maintain. 2 To purify, to cleanse.
णिद: णिद (इ) णिदि r. 1st cl. (निन्दति-ते प्रणिन्दति) also (ऋ) णिदृ r. 1st cl. (नेदति-ते प्रणेदति) 1 To abuse, to censure, to reproach, to reprove or revile, to despise or condemn, &c. (The second root means also) 2 To approach, to come near. The change of ण after a preposition is optional in the derivatives of the first of these roots.
णिल: णिल r. 6th cl. (निलति) 1 To misunderstand, to comprehend ill or imperfectly. 2 To be thick or impenetrable.
णिव: णिव (इ) णिवि r. 1st cl. (निन्वति प्रणिन्वति) To wet, to moisten, to sprinkle.
णिश: णिश r. 1st cl. (नेशति प्रणेशति) To meditate profoundly.
णिष: णिष r. 1st cl. (उ) णिषु (नेषति) To sprinkle, to shed as water.
णिस: णिस (इ) णिसि r. 2nd cl. (निंस्ते प्रणिंस्ते) To kiss: the change of ण after a preposition is optional in the derivatives.
णी: णी (ञ) णीञ् r. 1st cl. (नयति-ते) 1 To conduct, to drive or guide, to cause progressive conveyance. 2 To obtain, to get. The root is inflected as the deponent verb, implying. 1 Instruction, as नयते शास्त्रे he instructs in the Śāstra; 2 Worshipping, विष्णुंनयते he worships VIṢṆU; also with prepositions in the sense of; 1 Paying, भृत्यमुपनयते he pays the hire; 2 Paying as a debt, ऋणम्विनयते he discharges the debt; 3 Casting or lifting up, दण्डमुन्नयते he lifts up the stick; 4 Giving, द्रव्यम्बिनयते he gives the things; and 5 Brahmanical Investiture, पुत्त्रमुपनयते he invests his son with the thread: it is also deponent, governing an incorporeal object existing in the agent, as क्रोधम्विनयते he suppresses wrath; if the object is not in the agent the verb is active, as गुरोःक्रोधम्विनयति he appeases his teacher's anger; as also if the object is corporal, as गण्डं विनयति he turns away the cheek. The root occurs with many prefixes, and in a great variety of meanings; 1 With अनु, ^a To ask, to entreat. ^b To make like or resembling. ^c To favour. 2 With अप, ^a To take away, to remove. ^b To attract. 3 With अभि, 3 To indicate by signs. ^b To be kind or civil to. 4 With आङ्, To bring. 5 With उत्, To raise up. 6 With उप, To approach, to go near to, (see also above.) 7 With दुर्, To act or behave wickedly. 8 With निर्, ^a To get or obtain. ^b To ascertain, to determine. 9 With परि, ^a To marry. ^b To take cognizance of. 10 With प्र, ^a To punish. ^b To love. 11 With वि, ^a To take away, to make remote or distant. ^b To be humble or modest. 12 With वि and अप, To remove, to dispel, to disperse. 13 With वि and निर्, To decide by law. 14 With सम्, ^a To collect. ^b To discharge. 15 With सम् and अनु, To intreat. 16 With सम and आङ्, To assemble, to collect, &c.
णील: णील r. 1st cl. (नीलति प्रणीलति) 1 To be blue. 2 To make or dye blue.
णीव: णीव r. 1st cl. (नीवति प्रणीबति) To be large or corpulent.
णु: णु r. 3rd cl. (नौति प्रणौति) To praise. With आङ् prefixed (आनुते) To utter a cry of regret. r. 6th cl. (नवति) To praise.
णुद: णुद r. 6th cl. (औ) औणुद (नुदति नुदते) 1 To cast, to command, to direct, to throw or send; the act of ordering being considered analogous to that of throwing. 2 To go or proceed. With अप, To remove. With निर्, 1 To throw out. 2 To confess, to acknowledge. With वि, To be happy. With सं in the causal To drive, (as horses.)
णू: णू r. 6th cl. (नुवति) To praise; also ण.
णेद: णेद (ऋ) णेदृ r. 1st cl. (नेदति-ते) 1 To censure, to despise. 2 To approach or come near: see णिद.
णेष: णेष (ऋ) णेषृ r. 1st cl. (नेषते) To go, to move or approach. त
